title: Luminous Device Workload Fabric placement and result negative-control corpus
normative_note: Every device, resource estimate, evidence state, session, lease, network condition and result is synthetic. Values are test inputs, not measured hardware facts, security claims or product capabilities.
candidate_schema_notes: The work request describes constraints and never grants execution authority.
Xenia session identity, Mycelix local authority, device posture, runtime execution, task correctness and effect authorization are separate dimensions.
A valid signature does not prove task correctness.
This corpus is not itself an independent verifier; an independent evaluator must implement the expected dispositions without trusting the fixture generator.
